programme.title: 前途無量

programme.title: 我要逆風去
programme.desc: 我要逆風去是一部都市情感與勵志職場劇，講述民族服飾品牌在電商經濟衝擊下復興的歷程自香港投行跳槽回內地投資公司發展的投資人徐斯（龔俊飾），結識了國牌服裝集團董事長獨生女江湖（鍾楚曦飾），二人因商業理念不同而互不對盤江湖父親的企業突然破產，江湖一夜之間由雲端跌落谷底而一直頗有事業野心的徐斯對江湖父親曾經一手打造的膠底鞋品牌騰嶽勢在必得，使得落魄的江湖決定不惜一切保住騰嶽經一番周旋較量，最終徐斯與江湖立下是否能夠復興騰嶽的存亡生死契

programme.title: 爸爸的木匠小屋第三季
林則徐 虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 2025年，適逢民族英雄林則徐誕辰二百四十周年國家主席習近平在福州任職期間，保育了林則徐出生地的一系列遺跡他先後多次引用林則徐苟利國家生死以，豈因禍福避趨之的名句，號召國人把林則徐的民族精神和優秀品格繼承發揚下去ampampampltbrampampampgt林則徐：虎門銷煙以外是一部由香港電台出品的五集歷史人文紀錄片影片以香港視角出發，跨越三萬公里深入中國多省市（包括澳門廣東湖南福建浙江河南陝西甘肅新疆），更東渡日本，探尋虎門銷煙之外那個更為真實立體的林則徐ampampampltbrampampampgt林則徐虎門銷煙的壯舉固然永載史冊，但其光輝遠不止於此本紀錄片突破傳統敘事框架，不僅回顧林則徐虎門銷煙的功績，更深入挖掘他作為治水能臣嚴謹學者流放者與思想家的多面人生透過實地探訪專家訪談，並結合AI技術生成動畫重現歷史場景，影片呈現林則徐在禁煙海防水利邊疆開發等方面的卓越貢獻，並揭示其開眼看世界的深遠影響節目以細膩的鏡頭語言和情感敘述，串聯歷史與當下，展現林則徐精神的當代意義，值此民族英雄誕辰二百四十周年之際，向他獻上最誠摯的敬意本片由ampampamplt香港電台ampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 澳門人澳門事
programme.desc: 活在澳門, 感受生活,ampampampltbrampampampgtampampamplt澳門人．澳門事ampampampgt,ampampampltbrampampampgt探索城市每個角落關注民生議題繁華背後發掘一個又一個澳門人的故事欣賞各地藝術風采推廣本土文化藝術重溫舊城舊事，翻開當中的歷史記憶走過不同地方，感受人民風情緊貼你的生活資訊節目

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 신비아파트:고스트볼의 비밀
programme.desc: 귀신이 나오는 장소로 유명한 신비아파트, 그것도 444호에 이사 오게 된 하리네 가족. 첫날부터 그들은 자꾸만 이상한 일들에 휩싸이게 된다. 아무도 안 산다는 위층에선 밤새 쿵쿵거리는 소리가 울리고, 아파트 맨홀에서 기어 나온 괴상한 꼬마 아이는 자꾸만 내기를 하자며 하리에게 덤벼든다. 그러다 얼떨결에 꼬마 아이가 입에 달고 다니는 엿을 빼앗아 먹게 된 하리와 동생 두리. 그 이후부터 그들의 눈엔 하나둘 무서운 귀신의 모습이 보이기 시작하고, 정체를 알 수 없는 맨홀 꼬마는 귀신을 없애주면 원하는 소원은 뭐든지 이루어주겠다며 큰소리치는데...

programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 錦衣之下
programme.desc: 天賦異稟的六扇門女捕快袁今夏因為一樁案件和性情狠辣的錦衣衛陸繹結下樑子，今夏本以為此生與他再無交集，奈何冤家路窄朝廷十萬兩修河款不翼而飛，今夏奉命協助陸繹一起下揚州查案，替朝廷找回丟失的官銀本是道不同不相為謀，卻因驚天密案聯手兩人從勢同水火到刮目相看再到情難自已，命運的齒輪從此旋轉在一起然而事與願違，今夏竟是當年夏然案的遺孤，背負家族血仇的她與陸繹之間橫生了無法跨越的鴻溝最後，兩個有情人歷經苦難，為救百姓抗倭寇除奸佞，放下家族仇怨，聯手對敵，衝破世俗枷鎖，勇敢地走到了一起

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 跆拳對決
programme.desc: 有著輝煌跆拳道歷史的萬世高中，近幾年卻逐漸走下坡，面臨社員減少總教練出走，跆拳道社即將解體校長只好出面和即將被退學的不良學生談條件，以參加跆拳道比賽代替退學懲罰混混們的老大永客（金烔完飾）時常與跆拳道社長閔奎（玄彬飾）起衝突，看不順眼的兩人，該如何帶領跆拳道社團打進決賽？

programme.title: 我們全家不太熟
programme.desc: 即將畢業的威力苦惱著是否要繼承父親衣缽室友大胖遲遲不敢跟暗戀的女生告白另一個室友啞牙則是沒自信的怪咖迷惘的三人某天回到家，發現一個裝滿錢的信封，便拿去花光了此時，赴澳洲打工的好友卡卡帶了一個嬰兒回家，原來那些錢是準備付給保母的，無力償還的三人只好硬著頭皮接下了保母工作！

programme.title: 野夏天
programme.desc: 知名作家吳又立落魄前馬拉松選手高繼書，和一群跑隊的少年，命中注定般的相遇吳又立跟隊採訪，踏入高繼書不堪的過往，從他出任即將解散的高中跑隊，讓一群因為各種原因加入的少年人生產生了波瀾接連不斷的選擇使所有人陷入無法擺脫的漩渦中他們要怎麼與彼此與自己和解？

programme.title: 第一爐香
programme.desc: 上海女學生葛薇龍（馬思純飾）來香港求學，投靠姑媽梁太太（俞飛鴻飾），卻反被梁太太利用，將她當作誘餌吸引男人，葛薇龍漸漸沉溺在紙醉金迷中後來她被花花公子喬琪喬（彭于晏飾）吸引，為求繼續聲色犬馬的上流社會生活，不惜出賣自己的靈魂，費盡心機嫁給了喬琪喬，然最終卻淪為姑媽梁太太和喬琪喬斂財的工具

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: 重案組探員家駒不滿上頭釋放重犯朱滔，憤而辭職偕女友阿美出遊，恰巧遇到炸彈狂徒犯案，恐嚇接二連三，目標直指警局，警方不知所措，唯有重召家駒歸隊負責此案狂徒多番出動皆未得手後，竟起意綁架阿美以威脅家駒，家駒拼死直搗賊巢，不料貨倉已安裝炸彈

programme.title: 霍元甲之精武天下
programme.desc: 清朝末年，八國聯軍入侵後，日軍趁機進駐天津開設武館，展開征服中國的第一步此舉激發了天津習武之人的愛國意識，一代宗師霍元甲將代表天津的武者們，接受日本武術的挑戰，守護鄉里眾人的尊嚴

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: 一次電話線故障，促成方氏三兄弟的三段姻緣大哥方劍輝（黃百鳴飾）品性敦厚，與失婚婦人吳芬芳（馮寶寶飾）由冤家發展成戀人；天性風流的二哥方劍郎（周潤發飾）瞞著女友飄紅（鄭裕玲飾），與熱情如火的美麗（鍾楚紅飾）迅即擦出火花；三弟方劍笙（張學友飾）性格害羞，與在公園邂逅的開朗少女瑩瑩（袁潔瑩飾）萌芽出一段細水長流的純潔愛情三段姻緣來得意外，結局卻各有不同

programme.title: 失孤
programme.desc: 只有在路上，我才感覺我是個父親1998年老雷年僅兩歲的兒子遭拐，從此下落不明爾後老雷騎著一台綁著尋人啟事的破舊機車，十多年來尋遍中國，途中他邂逅了俊朗的小夥子曾帥，仿佛是命運安排，曾帥竟和老雷的兒子有著相似的遭遇兩人決定結伴同行，一個為想找到失蹤的兒子；一個想找到夢迴的故鄉

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: 民國初年，富貴鄉紳任老爺的先父當年威逼利誘求得一塊風水寶地，經風水先生指點，下葬二十年後必須起墳遷葬，才能澤被子孫任老爺請來道士九叔和他的兩個徒弟文才秋生協助遷葬，未料屍體已化作殭屍文才不慎被殭屍咬傷，秋生亦為美艷女鬼所迷，由此展開一場惡鬥

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: 老丁曾是個功力深厚的軍人，退休後某日帶外孫女到公園玩時，竟讓外孫女走失，家人難以釋懷也不再往來自責的老丁失智症狀更為嚴重，獨自在東北邊境生活，鄰居李政久的女兒小春花勾起老丁對外孫女的記憶，一老一小成了忘年之交但李政久卻捲入中俄黑幫大仇殺，小春花被綁架，老丁決定挺身而出，尋回軍人的驕傲及彌補身為爺爺的過錯，他能否以一人之力擊退黑幫，救回小春花呢？

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: 為了有效降低社會犯罪率整頓已經紛亂不堪的地下博彩業，政府聯合警方和博彩協會，嚴密展開打擊地下賭場的行動，並將新建賭場經營權拍賣處理以肅清博彩業，但不為人知的利益和秘密，卻引發賭城風雲與各方人馬衝突

programme.title: 血緣共犯
programme.desc: 15年前一件誘拐殺人案震驚全國，然而警方始終無法偵破在追訴期即將结束時，多恩（孫藝珍飾）偶然聽到犯人的聲音，腦中聯想起的畫面卻是自己的父親可怕的猜測令多恩陷入混亂，她無法將殘暴的兇手和總是為自己付出一切的父親連結在一起為了找出真相，她絕望地對父親展開調查

programme.title: 遊戲爆報新
programme.desc: 遊戲爆報新

programme.title: 夜半歌聲
programme.desc: 1926年的北京，青年演員宋丹平（張國榮飾）因主演歌劇迷倒成千上萬女性，卻與清純富家女杜雲嫣（吳倩蓮飾）墜入愛河然因戲子身份遭杜父反對，杜雲嫣被禁閉在家，許配給某豪門顯貴訂婚夜宴上，杜雲嫣佯病離席私會宋丹平，未婚夫發現後妒火中燒，派人毒打宋丹平並放火焚燒劇院杜雲嫣自此成為外人眼中的瘋婦，而已成廢墟的劇院每逢月圓之夜總傳來虛無縹緲的歌聲

programme.title: 執法先鋒
programme.desc: 檢察官夏令正為主持正義懲惡揚善，不惜鋌而走險，以法外手段殺死嫌疑人

programme.title: 暗戰
programme.desc: 劉德華在片中飾演罹患癌症只剩下4星期生命的華，劉青雲則是飾演警察談判組談判專家何尚生，兩人展開了一場72小時鬥智鬥膽的遊戲杜琪峯以其最擅長的警匪片手法執導劉德華憑藉這部電影拿下個人第一座香港電影金像獎最佳男主角獎

programme.title: 畫皮：情滅
programme.desc: 東海龍女阿若詐死留在凡間，和前世因救她而遁入凡世的王生成婚然而狐妖覬覦阿若體內可讓妖成人的叱玄靈葉，用計害死王生，使阿若情急之下用靈葉替王生續命少了靈葉的阿若無法抑制體內被封印的妖帝，命在旦夕，王生更被狐妖迷惑，心碎的阿若一面抵抗妖帝，一面與狐妖對峙，掙扎著保護變心了的王生

programme.title: 妖貓傳
programme.desc: 故事發生在盛唐時期的長安城，白樂天本是朝廷要官，卻為了收集寫詩的素材而甘願被貶為起居郎長安城內連連發生離奇的死亡事件，就連當今聖上也難逃厄運離奇身亡，這一切都和一隻神出鬼沒的妖貓有關日本僧人空海本為了替皇帝解咒遠渡重洋而來，卻和白樂天意氣相投，兩人決心攜手調查案件真相

programme.title: 偉大的隱藏者
programme.desc: 北韓南派組織的3名間諜，爲了完成任務分別僞裝成智障搖滾青年和高中生潛伏於南韓鄉下，發生一連串既搞笑又驚險刺激的諜戰故事長時間在南韓的生活，以及受到善良熱心鄰居的影響，讓他們逐漸對自己的信念產生質疑

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2
programme.desc: 秦奮決心與笑笑白頭到老，笑笑對秦奮的感情卻止於好感，在秦奮好友的離婚典禮啟發下，兩人決定先從試婚開始然而秦奮深沉的愛意卻對笑笑帶來無形的壓力，兩人只能分道揚鑣距離遠了，感情好像也就淡了，在兩人似乎已忘記對方的同時，他們生活的軌跡又再次交錯，在好友點化下，笑笑似乎明白了婚姻的真諦

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道人擅長茅山道術，和徒弟阿豪與一隻小殭屍住在一個小鎮上鄰鎮瘟疫蔓延，不時有殭屍出沒，一眉道人帶徒弟與小殭屍前去抓鬼，發現鄰鎮的飲用水源都被屍毒污染，在教堂地下室發現了殭屍的痕跡原來此處一具西洋殭屍意外復活，一場中國法術對付西洋殭屍的精彩好戲於焉上演

programme.title: 雞排英雄
programme.desc: 匯集台灣各路美食小吃的八八八夜市，每日都洋溢著喜悅的氣氛，夜市自治會會長阿華負責調解夜市糾紛以維護攤販利益一晚，女記者林亦南在夜市附近出車禍，生活自此陷入一連串混亂，工作不順加上失戀，還因毀壞電路被罰在八八八進行社區服務，幸得阿華與眾攤販化解亦南身在異鄉的孤獨然議員張進亮被地產商收買，欲強徵八八八土地，阿華帶領攤販向政商宣戰，而張進亮與阿華之間的往事也逐漸浮出水面

programme.title: 謎密
programme.desc: 一位患有失眠症的拖車司機在父親突逝後回到童年的家中，卻發現屋子裡有著超自然現象並徘徊在此聖地中無法消散

programme.title: 醉後怨偶
programme.desc: 同居五年的艾倫與妮娜決定分手，過程平靜到周圍親友都覺得不可思議分手後的某天，兩人卻不約而同在以前最常去的酒吧相遇，然而這次卻氣氛火爆，雙方都堅持要對方離開現場，酒保只好提議用遊戲方式決定兩人的去留隨著瘋狂的酒吧爭奪戰開打，表面上心平氣和的兩人，內心的火氣也逐漸顯露無遺

programme.title: 緊急撤離
programme.desc: 伊拉克入侵伊朗初期，阿巴丹當地一家廣播電台裡的一群年輕人，試圖在薩達姆軍隊的炮擊和轟炸下維持電台運作，同時為人們帶來希望

programme.title: 父親
programme.desc: 罹患失智症的安東尼，隨著年齡增長，他所認知的世界與現實逐漸產生差距即使充滿疑惑，他卻無法接受自己患病的事實，更拒絕女兒安所安排的一切協助與照顧隨著病情急轉直下，他逐漸遺忘時間空間，甚至是自己摯愛的親人

programme.title: 獵殺遊戲
programme.desc: 在一個無人居住的島嶼上，八名真人秀參賽者必須在獵殺遊戲中設法存活下來這不僅僅是一個遊戲，還是一場試煉一連串的選擇，以及一面印照出真理與人性謊言的鏡子

programme.title: 復仇殺神
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊成員麥斯回家發現老婆和身為FBI探員的哥哥被殘忍地謀殺，而他的寶貝女兒也不知去向，這突如其來的衝擊讓麥斯陷入極度的悲慟，警方開始調查整件命案的緣由，但麥斯不想就這樣交由警方處理，深陷悲傷和仇恨的他決定自己展開行動，找回女兒，但也因為這樣讓他越陷越深，這將會是一場血腥暴力的復仇之路

programme.title: 諜中諜
programme.desc: 這是改編自波蘭英雄楊・諾瓦克經歷的真實故事楊・諾瓦克曾在二次大戰的高峰期間，英勇擔任波蘭與倫敦的流亡政府之使者，因而被稱為華沙使者不顧所有軸心國密使追捕他，他帶著至關波蘭及戰爭命運的密令偷渡至倫敦，並在路途中沿路被德軍跟蹤演出一場諜報大戰，此時卻結識了改變他一生的戰士們

programme.title: 閃閃小超人電影版
programme.desc: 閃閃是個六歲的小超人，他與一群好朋友在超能力學校上課，不過只剩他還沒找到屬於自己的超能力在這個宇宙中，還有一個邪惡的馬斯星球馬斯國王非常討厭小孩的歡笑聲，於是他密謀一個邪惡計劃，打算讓所有的小孩從此失去笑容某天，超能力學校突然出現一個從來都不笑的小女孩梅格，閃閃和她變成了好搭檔不同的星球全新的朋友，以及前所未見的怪物，閃閃與梅格要如何攜手合作，打倒馬斯國王保護這個宇宙呢？

programme.title: 緣來想見妳
programme.desc: 法國鄉村主廚史蒂芬，生活就是圍繞在前妻兩個兒子，以及他的主廚事業打轉當他在Instagram上認識一位韓國女子秀，終於感受到渴望已久的那份悸動，決定拋下一切，飛往首爾與她見面但抵達首爾後，原本該來接機的秀並未出現，史蒂芬更因為種種理由受困機場，他開始在Instagram上不斷發文，因而轟動全網變成機場級網紅究竟史蒂芬這場意亂情迷的跨國追愛之旅，最終能否成功呢？

programme.title: 冰血殺機
programme.desc: 美國鑽石商人盧卡斯前往俄羅斯進行交易卻因故告吹，搭檔也人間蒸發盧卡斯與西伯利亞咖啡館的女店長卡提雅萌生情愫，在危機四伏的鑽石交易市場裡，兩人要如何安然逃離凶險的西伯利亞？

programme.title: 魔女神兵
programme.desc: 十四世紀的法國，貝曼（尼可拉斯凱吉飾）率領一群驍勇善戰的戰士，奉命押解一名被冠以女巫之名的女子上山，交由僧侶作法驅魔經過朝夕相處，戰士們對年輕女子的罪名產生懷疑和困惑，儘管世人堅稱巫女魔力是當時黑死病肆虐的根源，但他們依舊抱有懷疑勇士們遊走於任務與正義之間，友誼也因此受到空前考驗

programme.title: 惡夜性追緝
programme.desc: 佛羅里達州的彭薩柯拉市數年來發生了許多年輕女性失蹤和死亡的案件，由於受害者者大多是妓女或逃家青少年，因此案件一直不受重視當地警探拜倫（艾米爾荷許飾）決定揪出背後的連續殺人魔，為死者伸張正義，而FBI探員蕾貝卡（梅根福克斯飾）和卡爾（布魯斯威利飾）也發現這些命案的關聯，並展開誘捕行動，他們三人能將這名極惡人魔繩之以法嗎？

programme.title: 馬雅預言：12劫
programme.desc: 古老的馬雅預言指示著，聖誕前夕的接連天災會將一座小鎮推向毀滅邊緣，稱為聖誕十二劫，唯有天選之人能阻止末日到來一名父親發現女兒正是天選之人，但憤怒的小鎮居民卻遷怒於她，並誓言要讓她為家園毀滅負責！

programme.title: 地球戰疫
programme.desc: 一場全球性大流行的致命傳染病導致地球上90的人口死亡之後，現在世界上僅有年輕人和免疫者倖存艾莉和奎因在末日後的世界中掙扎求生，但又同時被無情地追捕著，他們的旅程處處都是危險

programme.title: 腥鞋遊戲
programme.desc: 富豪發起名為搶奪紅色高跟鞋的高額獎金遊戲，最終贏家將可獲得金錢與權力，但最高原則是：突破道德界線的玩法才有資格被認可！殘虐的遊戲就此失控展開，直到她的出現

programme.title: 逃出夏魘祭
programme.desc: 她與閨蜜們原本計畫度過一個開心的週末湖邊別墅之旅，未料慘遭邪教綁架，她要如何殺出重圍避免淪為獻祭的供品？

programme.title: 上流謀殺案
programme.desc: 1934年的英國南方，六位素昧平生的陌生人被邀請至億萬富翁路易斯芬利擁有的遺世獨居小島上作客但一場突如其來的兇殺案奪走其中一位房客的性命，聰慧且強悍的美麗客人米蘭達格林不得不展開調查，直至真相水落石出！

programme.title: 英勇交錯
programme.desc: 一個在困境中生活的年輕男孩一位英勇的士兵，以及一名來自遠方的不速之客，在黑海山丘上所交織而成的真實故事

programme.title: 倒數救援戰
programme.desc: 聖戰分子發動襲擊後，唯一倖存的黨羽哈姆札抓住桑提作為人質，桑提意外成了恐怖分子，他穿著炸彈背心穿梭在馬德里的格蘭大道，情報機構緊急應變小組，甚至媒體，全都動員起來設法拯救他的性命，這場驚心動魄的資源部署，卻迎來了意想不到的結果

programme.title: 獵殺侏儸紀
programme.desc: 2030年第三次世界大戰期間，一群倖存者逃入一座地下碉堡兩年後，他們必須離開碉堡找尋補給，但隨之而來的卻是恐龍的獵殺

programme.title: 絕命3小時
programme.desc: 曾是歷史地標的堡高醫院，荒廢已久並面臨即將拆除的命運，但某幫派卻在此藏了九千萬，隨著消息傳開，兩個敵對黑幫虎視眈眈，想要找出這筆贓款，未料卻被拆除工人麥可搶先發現，而距離建物爆破拆除期限僅剩短短三小時

programme.title: 童心馬戲團
programme.desc: 10歲的瑟希樂跟母親剛回到鄉下，她還不太適應那裡的生活這時正好來了一組巡迴馬戲團大家爭先恐後，都想一睹小馬波力的風采然而瑟希樂卻發現波力受到主人柏卡魯的虐待她想拯救波力她將波力藏了起來，不讓大人發現，並且意外地獲得神秘的維托及村裡其他小孩的幫助為了逃脫柏卡魯的追尋，瑟希樂跟波力展開了一段充滿驚喜的冒險

programme.title: 威利的異星大冒險
programme.desc: 隨著太空船因意外事故爆炸，在逃生過程中小威利被迫與家人分開，他的救生船降落到一顆原始無人的星球在那裏，他唯一的夥伴和依靠是一台古怪又能幹的維生機器人巴克由於與父母相聚的日子遙遙無期，救援船也遲遲未出現，威利必須設法在這個充滿怪奇生物的星球奮勇求生！

programme.title: 即刻反擊
programme.desc: 美樂莉是個身手矯健的美女特務，她受雇於神秘的地下組織，專門橫越全球執行政府不敢出面的危機任務然而當美樂莉在愛爾蘭執行任務時，身分遭到背叛曝光，成為所有國際間諜的刺殺目標性命危在旦夕的美樂莉，必須運用特務的技巧，逃過重重殺陣返回美國，瓦解遭到滲透的組織與背後的陰謀主使！

programme.title: 致命彈片
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊員與他的老戰友槓上墨西哥販毒集團，試圖找出失蹤女兒的下落

programme.title: 將軍之夜
programme.desc: 二戰德軍佔領區，情報處格勞少校奉命調查一宗手段兇殘的華沙謀殺案，死者是一名具有情報員身分的妓女，有三位將軍涉案，但三人都不願配合調查兩年後，巴黎又發生一起手法類似的命案，已升格為上校的格勞認定坦斯將軍就是兇手，卻被坦斯以謀反黨羽之名而遭槍殺戰後多年，德國漢堡再度發生類似妓女命案，格勞戰時的法國警方好友莫隆督察，發覺坦斯是三起謀殺案真凶，於是開始尋找當年在巴黎被坦斯嫁禍而逃亡的德軍下士

programme.title: 波伽利：聲命之歌
programme.desc: 阿莫斯生來就擁有美妙嗓音，卻因為先天性眼疾進入盲人學校，之後又在一場足球比賽意外後完全失明個性好強的他，卻從未因此放棄自己對音樂的熱情與夢想在恩師（安東尼奧班德拉斯飾）的嚴厲指導下，他的歌唱技巧不斷提升與突破，終於獲得義大利國寶級搖滾明星蘇奇洛賞識，親自邀他同台獻唱，此後開始朝史上最成功的跨界男高音之路邁進

programme.title: 詹姆士龐德007之皇家夜總會
programme.desc: 英美蘇法四大情報巨頭齊聚一堂，一同前往已退休007詹姆士龐德爵士隱居的別墅，請他重出江湖對付神秘的犯罪組織SMERSH為讓龐德無所退路，M秘密下令將別墅炸毀，自己卻被流彈波及而身亡，龐德只得硬著頭皮接下軍情處主管之職為了混淆SMERSH，遂將所有執行不同任務的特務代號都稱為007詹姆士龐德，一群形形色色的間諜便在皇家夜總會展開一場天馬行空大亂鬥！

programme.title: 瞞天機密
programme.desc: 在英國情報機構任職的中文翻譯員凱薩琳，某天收到一封讓她備感震驚的電子郵件，內容顯示美國國安局為使聯合國安理會同意發動伊拉克戰爭，竟串通英國政府執行非法行動，企圖改變聯合國表決結果凱薩琳向媒體揭發此事，成功引發世界輿論的關注與譴責在此同時，她也因為違反國家機密法而遭控叛國罪她該如何對抗這個不公不義的政府？而這個世界又將如何回應她的勇氣呢？

programme.title: 哥吉拉
programme.desc: 潛伏自侏儸紀的大怪獸哥吉拉，突然地出現在東京沿海造成嚴重死傷生物學家山根博士原主張不予攻擊，但在目睹遍地瘡痍後終於認同消滅哥吉拉的行動最後在科學家芹澤犧牲自己使用秘密的氧氣破壞裝置後，與哥吉拉一同葬送在大海中

programme.title: 蘇乞兒之武功蓋世
programme.desc: 蘇燦出生於軍官家庭，自幼酷愛武術，進京趕武，卻遭禁毒陷害，家破人亡清朝末年，廣東十虎蘇乞兒決戰斧頭幫與江湖大盜，最後創立門派

programme.title: 獨行鐵金鋼
programme.desc: 在亞利桑那州印地安原住民保護區派尤特郡，無視紀律如牛仔般風流粗暴的鐵血副警長庫根，被派往紐約押解通緝犯林格曼回鄉受審來到事事講求法律人權的紐約大都會，庫根總顯得格格不入林格曼因毒癮發作被關押在戒護監獄，冗長的法律作業程序，讓不耐久候的庫根決定假借法官與紐約警方名義逕行將林格曼帶出監獄，卻在上機前被其同夥偷襲劫走受傷的庫根若空手而回將顏面無光，於是單槍匹馬開始在紐約市裡追捕逃犯！

programme.title: 女戰士
programme.desc: 西元60年，凱爾特戰士布狄卡與丈夫普拉蘇塔古斯共同統治著繁榮進步的愛西尼部落，丈夫去世後，王國無男嗣，羅馬人乘機奪取了她的土地和財產，陷入絕望的布狄卡決心復仇，她成功號召凱爾特與不列顛諸部落，聯手對抗入侵的羅馬帝國，掀起了一場前所未有的史詩戰爭

programme.title: 英雄訣53-54首
programme.desc: 英雄訣53-54首

programme.title: 惡水真相
programme.desc: 美國戰地攝影家尤金史密斯在二戰過後決定隱居，與社會和職業脫節，但生活雜誌編輯羅伯特海斯帶他來到日本熊本的水俁市，那是一個因日本窒素公司排放廢棄物而造成汞中毒的城市史密斯用相機紀錄人們受水俁病所苦的症狀，以及為公義所付出的努力他用一張張震懾人心的相片，為國際揭開這場令人心碎的歷史災難，也改變了當地居民的人生

programme.title: 蓬門碧玉紅顏淚
programme.desc: 1930年代美國密西西比小鎮，年輕英俊的歐文前來執行鐵路公司的裁員任務，與房東的女兒艾娃墜入情網但歐文令小鎮多人失業而備受當地人士排擠，艾娃的母親亦從中作梗，迫使這對愛侶分離

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍鐧，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天走向權力之路最大的威脅同時，洛陽城發生諸多離奇事件面對空前危機，狄仁傑要如何保住亢龍鐧？

programme.title: 孤雛淚
programme.desc: 英國維多利亞時期，身世不明的孤兒奧利佛困苦度日某日奧利佛只為多求得一碗粥而被認為不服管教轉賣給殯儀館當學徒，依舊擺脫不了受虐的命運，於是逃亡到倫敦，輾轉進入扒竊集團並被誤認為竊嫌，幸得目擊者於法庭上證明無辜富有的竊案失主布朗洛先生為補償奧利佛而將他帶回收留，殊不知他正是失蹤多年姪女的遺腹子

programme.title: 最好的我們
programme.desc: 一張舊照片，映入了攝影師耿耿的眼簾觸動了當年回憶的開關在那個恣意揮灑的青春年代裡，耿耿和資優生余淮成了鄰座校園內充斥著少男少女們懵懂青澀的賀爾蒙耿耿和余淮也不例外，兩人相約高考後再相見，但當耿耿滿懷期待前往約定之地，余淮卻像人間蒸發般渺無音訊當年余淮懸在嘴邊未說出的話那不辭而別的秘密，到底是什麼？

programme.title: 死神騎馬來
programme.desc: 十五年前的梅斯塔牧場，比爾一家人慘遭搶匪集團滅門，只有小比爾被一名晚到搶匪藏於馬車下而逃過一劫親眼目睹家人慘死的比爾，多年來苦練槍法一心復仇，在追查的過程中遇上甫出獄的中年牛仔瑞恩，兩人似乎有著共同的目標，帶著既像競爭又像合作的方式將匪徒逐一揪出擊斃，而比爾也漸漸發現瑞恩其實隱藏著一段秘密

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 雲襄傳
programme.desc: 陳曉攜手毛曉彤闖江湖，智武雙全亂世見真情！！雲襄背負雲台門使命開始於江湖中走盪，因意外結識瀟灑帶勁的俠女舒亞男等其他能力之士而成為好友一同在波譎雲詭的江湖紛爭中成長理解仁德與尋找正義眾人尋覓禍亂天下的陰謀逐漸明朗時，雲襄決定挺身而出捍衛一切，守住天下大義

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.desc: Tim Dunn takes a look at the architecture of the Stockton and Darlington railway, the first passenger steam line in the world and learns how Essexs enormous Chappel Viaduct was built

programme.title: Archaeology: A Secret History
programme.desc: Richard Miles concludes his series charting the history of archaeological breakthroughs by discovering more about the ancient common man. The investigation takes the archaeologist from the elaborate grave of Egyptian boy king Tutankhamun to the Danish resting place of the Tollund Man, who died as part of an Iron Age sacrifice more than 2,000 years ago

programme.title: Mastermind: 1977
programme.desc: Magnus Magnusson hosts the fifth heat of the quiz, with specialist subjects of the Spanish anarchist movement 1908-1975, the operas of Benjamin Britten, the history of the Royal Navy 1794-1805, and the Berry novels of Dornford Yates

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson presides over another duel of words and wits as Jenny Agutter, Sinead Cusack, Tim Rice and Nigel Dempster join team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Campbell. First broadcast in 1978

programme.title: The Search for the Lost Manuscript: Julian of Norwich
programme.desc: Historian Janina Ramirez tells the story of the first book written in English by a woman, Revelations of Divine Love by Julian of Norwich. The book was written in 1373 and presents an alternative viewpoint on mans relationship with God, which led to it being suppressed for more than 500 years. She travels from Norwich to Cambrai in Northern France, revealing how the book survived and the stories of women who championed it, and consults with academics and theologians about the books importance

programme.title: Romancing the Stone: The Golden Ages of British Sculpture
programme.desc: Alastair Sooke examines the three golden ages of British sculpture and the technical breakthroughs that made them possible. He begins with a look at the Norman ecclesiastical building programme and the masterworks created by anonymous medieval masons and artisans to the glory of God - until Henry VIIIs Reformation brought wholesale destruction

programme.title: Nature and Us: A History Through Art
programme.desc: James Fox uses art to explore how humans began to try to understand nature for the very first time. From the Song dynasty in China and the Islamic world, through to the Scientific Revolution and the advent of the industrial era, he shows the very different ways in which humans came to both appreciate and understand nature

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: In Perth, crewmates Ashleigh and Stuart head to a city centre car park where John is struggling with chest pains. Reluctant to cause a fuss, he describes his pain as mild, but when the team carry out an ECG reading of his heart, the results are alarming. Meanwhile, central Scotland is enduring hurricane-force winds and Phil and Ryan of the Special Operations Response Team deploy from their base in Renfrewshire to go to a serious car crash

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: With the days getting shorter and the nights cooler George Anderson and Calum Clunie are at the stage of reviewing some of the planting projects they started in the Spring at Beechgrove. A new addition was Calums family plot, based on the size of a standard garden of a new-build property, this week he is harvesting and assessing just how productive that area has been. George and Calum will be in the trials bed and comparing how the various club root resistant varieties of brassica have performed after that infection was found in this area of the garden. The pair will also be visiting the grass garden that was completely overhauled and replanted at the start of the series. There are visits to Beechgrove regulars Jenna McDonald at her allotment in Perth and Colin Crosbies plot just outside Dumfries, as well as the weeks handy hints

programme.title: Race Against the Tide
programme.desc: Iain Stirling challenges the five remaining teams to create monsters out of sand, with the duos battling six hours of gale-force winds and the tide to carve their most gruesome creations yet. programme.title: Ultras
programme.desc: The organised groups of supporters in Scottish football who are transforming matchdays, inspired by European terrace culture and amplified through social media. Mark Bonnar narrates

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sophie Willan presents a week dedicated to literary icons, beginning with the sewers tackling a pattern for arguably the most famous hat in all of literature - Sherlock Holmes deerstalker. In the transformation round they must imagine what Roald Dahls heroine Matilda would be like as an adult and craft her an outfit from a second-hand school uniform, before a made-to-measure challenge to make a Regency outfit inspired by the works of Jane Austen

programme.title: Blackmailed: The Sextortion Killers
programme.desc: Reporter Tir Dhondy investigates the rise of sextortion scams targeting teenage boys on social media, including the case of 16-year-old victim Evan Boettler. Her journey leads to Nigeria, where she confronts the scammers taking part in these crimes. With unprecedented access and interviews with industry insiders, Tir exposes a disturbing online underworld and its devastating consequences

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Part one of two. The team is called to the scene of a drive-by shooting outside a London nightclub, joined by detectives from Operation Trident investigating a turf war between drug gangs. programme.desc: Coverage of day nine of the Grand Slam at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Flushing Meadows, New York, where the fourth round is scheduled to continue. Iga Swiatek secured her place in last years quarter-finals with a straightforward 6-3 6-1 win over Ekaterina Alexandrova, as she continued her quest to win this event for a second time after first being triumphant in 2022. Elsewhere, Karolna Muchov was made to work hard in her victory over Marta Kostyuk, eventually prevailing 6-3 6-7 6-3

programme.title: Live US Open Tennis
programme.desc: Coverage of day nine of the Grand Slam at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Flushing Meadows, New York, where the fourth round is scheduled to continue. programme.title: Jewan Of Vellimala
programme.desc: The residents of a small village named Vellimala decide to build a dam against the wishes of the government.

programme.title: Kerala Varma Pazhassiraja
programme.desc: Kerala Varma, finds refuge in Wayanad forests, and engages in guerrilla warfare. Release Year: 2009 Director: Hariharan

programme.title: Nerariyan C.B.I.
programme.desc: A CBI officer investigates the murder of a young woman in a haunted mansion years after the crime occurred. Release Year: 2005 Director: K. Madhu

programme.title: One
programme.desc: Severe allegations challenge a politicians integrity. Release Year: 2021 Director: Santhosh Viswanath

programme.title: Bramayugam

programme.title: Bheeshmaparvam
programme.desc: Michael controls the Anjootti family with strict rules, but the younger generation rebels. When they join his enemies, Michael must confront his forgotten past and make hard choices. Release Year: 2022 Director: Amal Neerad Awards: Kerala State Film Award for Best Makeup Artist

programme.title: Kannur Squad
programme.desc: George and his squad uncover a murder while tracking a political goon. Release Year: 2023 Director: Roby Varghese Raj

programme.title: The Priest
programme.desc: Priest and officer investigate suicides and uncover bigger crime. Release Year: 2021 Director: Jofin T. Chacko

programme.title: Kayyoppu
programme.desc: A writer reflects on life, relationships and memories, capturing emotional depth through simple moments that reveal profound truths about human connections. Release Year: 2007 Director: Ranjith

programme.title: Aug-15
programme.desc: Perumal investigates an assassination attempt on the Chief Minister of Kerala on 15th August. Release Year: 2011 Director: Shaji Kailas

programme.title: Snehaveedu
programme.desc: Ajayan cares for sick mother and shocked by boy claiming son. Release Year: 2011 Director: Sathyan Anthikad

programme.title: Action Hero Biju
programme.desc: Biju posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin has to handle notorious criminals. Release Year: 2016 Director: Abrid Shine

programme.title: Aadu 2
programme.desc: Shaji Pappan and friends compete in a tug-of-war to fund the arts club. Release Year: 2017 Director: Midhun Manuel Thomas

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: When only a skull is found, the ACP is tasked to find the victim and the killer. Release Year: 2021 Director: Tanu Balak

programme.title: Konti Karat
programme.desc: Sebuah program bual bicara yang berformat baru dan di hos kan oleh Shuib Sepahtu bersama-sama tetamu undangannya.

programme.title: Saloma Bhg2: Pandang Kaseh
programme.desc: Salmah bergelar Saloma dan bercinta dengan P. Ramlee.

programme.title: Ratu Ten Pin 2: Shalin
programme.desc: Adaptasi kisah suka duka pemain bowling kebangsaan iaitu Shalin Zulkifli mengejar gelaran pemain nombor satu Malaysia dan antarabangsa sehingga digelarkan Ratu Ten Pin.

programme.title: Eropah, Here I Am
programme.desc: Bukhary membawa diri ke Pulau Leros, Greece dan menjadi sukarelawan membantu pelarian Syiria. Di situ dia mempelajari nilai kehidupan dan kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Kutinggalkan Cinta di Okinawa

programme.title: Dalang Prank S2
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan hiburan prank yang melibatkan artis dan peserta yang menjadi dalang kepada prank masing-masing. Prank yang disukai oleh penonton akan dinobatkan Juara Dalang Prank dalam setiap episod.

programme.title: Mat Dan Kaki Jalan
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah travelog santai tentang perjalanan dan percutian seorang lelaki Inggeris Daniel Tayler atau dikenali sebagai Mat Dan berasal dari Cheltenham England ke Malaysia.

programme.title: Aiman Tempe Mania The Series
programme.desc: Saksikan Kamal Adli sebagai hos membawa selebriti bercuti bersama peminatnya dalam Curi-Curi Cuti di bawah kempen expeRIAnce.

programme.title: RASA Instafamous - Ideaktiv
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan resepi - resepi menarik setiap minggu yang dihoskan oleh Norzaini Abdul Halim Aunty Aini bersama sama instafamous jemputan.

programme.title: Dahlia

programme.title: Pewaris Cinta

programme.title: Travel With Mommy: Misi Anak Mak
programme.desc: Percutian yang penuh cabaran tugasan dalam masa yang sama setiap pasangan emak anak ini harus mengumpul lencana dihujung percutian. Siapa yang berjaya mengumpul lencana dengan banyak dikira pemenang.

programme.title: Tikus dan Kucing
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah cinta Mitha dan Jaenal yang tidak mendapat restu ibu bapa masing-masing, kerana ibu bapa mereka sering bertengkar, dan saling membenci.

programme.title: Sedapur Bersama
programme.desc: Sedapur Bersama adalah program masakan yang menambat hati penonton dengan berkongsikan resepi hidangan lazat dan nilai - nilai dalam perhubungan.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap The Series
programme.desc: Nini dan Haikal iaitu adik beradik tiri menjadi bosan apabila asyik bertukar rumah, justeru mereka merancang untuk menyatukan Hairi dan Lisa iaitu penjaga sementara mereka.

programme.title: Konsert Duo Star
programme.desc: Program nyanyian duet terbaru yang menggandingkan penyanyi-penyanyi popular tanah air bertanding di atas satu pentas

programme.title: Pewaris Cinta
programme.desc: Zaheem memberitahu Dylea, dia setuju membawa Iman bertemu Rosemaria tetapi Anita tiba-tiba muncul dan mendedahkan perihal wasiat Rosemaria.

programme.desc: Benjamin cant find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: I Just Like Worms
programme.desc: From snails called David to Daddy Spider Longlegs, the funny animals talk about all things creepy and crawly.

programme.title: Its Time to Play Schools
programme.desc: When JoJo and Gran Gran pick up JoJos cousin Lexi from school, JoJo wants to learn everything about what Lexi has been doing there. Its time for a Gran Gran plan - why dont they play schools when they get home? The cousins turn Gran Grans living room into a classroom ready for Lexi to become a teacher. Writing, science, reading, counting, drawing and music - theres lots to learn! Then its JoJos turn to play teacher, but what can she teach? After all, shes never been to school. Gran Gran

programme.title: TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggees old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, theyre on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodris front door.

programme.title: The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but cant find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Venice, Italy
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch demands the Grimbots find somewhere with no cars so he can practice riding his bike without stabilisers. He arrives in Venice and is delighted to find the streets are empty. With a splash, he discovers there are no cars because there are no streets in this city of canals and demands the Grimbots build him some roads. The Go Jetters and other tourists now find their gondola rides blocked by roads and concrete.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Monstertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea creates an evil version of her nemesis, Supertato. With the help of her hench-Cobs, Evil Pea makes a big, green lumbering spud that she names Monstertato!

programme.title: Merry Sprouty Day Part 1
programme.desc: Its Merry Sprouty Day, and everyone is waiting for Sprouty Claus, who is bringing presents to all the good fruit and veggies. However, Evil Pea has an evil plan - to steal the presents for herself!

programme.title: Tickly
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy doing Round and Round the Garden, especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.

programme.title: Apple
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say apple and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different apples and explore how they look and taste. We see a green apple, a red apple, a shiny apple and a smiling, bobbing apple! Dee tries a yummy apple in an Autumn scene, flies a flying apple and cheers up a crying apple. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally succeeds in saying todays word!

programme.title: Journey to Socktropolis
programme.desc: Zam tries out her new navigator, which takes the friends to Socktropolis. But when the batteries run out, how will they get back?

programme.title: Super Secret Swoptops
programme.desc: Its secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two supersecret spies follow her without being spotted?

programme.title: Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dads birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mums word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why its important not to break them.

programme.title: The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When theyre accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggees cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. Theres a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder whats going on at Squirrel Club. Theres a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us whats cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to the Valley of Balls in Kazakhstan, where they find thousands of rocks which are almost perfectly round. Meanwhile, Grandmaster Glitch is seeking the ideal ball to use to practise his bowling - something big and heavy. What could be better then one of the giant balls of rock from the Valley of Balls? But things start to go wrong for the Grandmaster when he rolls the ball of rock right out of Grim HQ and straight towards an unsuspecting group of tourists. The Go Jetters ta

programme.title: Mums and Dads
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they cant agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Handstand
programme.desc: At a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna cant find a way to make herself useful. Theyre both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but its a little different than hes used to... hes going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum wont let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Caf in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Andy and the Dino Tree Mystery
programme.desc: Andy meets a herd of Pachycephalosaurus and watches two males headbutting each other in a show of dominance.

programme.title: Jelly
programme.desc: Its party time in Playtime Towers, and Bella and Lift enjoy a wibbly-wobbly jelly treat. Over in Boxtropolis, this gives Sketch an idea to paint a jellyfish.

programme.title: The Dream Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they cant stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggees dream!

programme.title: The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, its gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of its ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters dont have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

programme.title: The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Mines of Mystery
programme.desc: Amidst Italys ancient sites and hidden treasures, Thomas is inspired to make his own special discovery and goes on a journey to find a lost legend.

programme.title: Museum
programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise theres nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: I Could Be The Best Dancer In The Whole Entire World
programme.desc: From disco dancing frogs to skipping puffins and lions that love ballet, the talking animals discuss the best things about dancing.

programme.title: Its Time to Look for Signs
programme.desc: On the way home from Jareds shop with Gran Gran, JoJo finds out about the signs around them and what they mean. They are everywhere, and they all have a job to do. When they get home, Gran Gran has a plan to help JoJo make some signs of her own - there are even some special ones that they can share with Jared.

programme.title: Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - its King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that finding their talents means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

programme.desc: Glitch has attached huge rocket boosters to Grim HQ in an attempt to become the first Grandmaster in space. As he thunders up into the night sky, it looks like he may actually do it this time. Then the boosters splutter to a stop and he crashes back to Earth. Glitch clambers to his feet amongst the wreckage of Grim HQ and demands the Grimbots find him another spaceship. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the Seattle Space Needle, a huge spire with a futuristic viewing platform made to look like

programme.title: Mines of Mystery
programme.desc: Amidst Italys ancient sites and hidden treasures, Thomas is inspired to make his own special discovery and goes on a journey to find a lost legend.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leaders illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary Tian Chan Gong and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Destinys Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girls heart.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Huas hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles Sonny Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 3 of 4.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA Amanda Lino vs. Rizlen Zouak
programme.desc: This episode features a womens banthamweight championship as Amanda Mad Dog Lino and Rizlen The Lioness of the Atlas Zouak fight their way to Fight of the Night honors. Bonus coverage showcases more striking power with Mzawandile Hlongwa vs. Robert Swanepoel and Steve Nwosu vs. Quinton Rossouw. From EFC 70 in Sibaya Casino, Durbin, South Africa on 26-May-2018.

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 Edison Miranda vs. Willie Gibbs
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features Super Middleweights Edison Miranda 26-2, 23 KOs vs. Willie The Gladiator Gibbs 20-1, 16 KOs from the Miccosukee Indian Gaming Resort in Miami, Florida, USA. Bonus coverage includes Jason Litzau, aka The American Boy 20-1, 18 KOs vs. Jose Hernandez 21-3, 13 KOs.

programme.title: Greatest Classics Hector Camacho vs. Tony Menefee
programme.desc: Hector Macho Camacho, always entertaining and flamboyant, stepping into the ring with 62-4 Tony Menefee in Lincoln, Nebraska. Camacho was on the comeback trail, following an up and down year that saw him defeat the legendary Sugar Ray Leonard by TKO before dropping a unanimous decision to Oscar De La Hoya for the WBC Welterweight Title. With his eyes on another title shot he faces Menefee, in the midst of a 14-fight win streak. The undercard would be stacked with talent as well, including V

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Andre Berto vs. Luis Collazo
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Andre Berto defending the WBC welterweight title against former WBA champion Luis Collazo. Each fighter had their own share of getting stunned throughout the bout, and the judges decision at the end will have some controversy. Also on the card, kickboxing takes center stage as super heavyweight legend Daniel Ghita takes on Gokhan Saki.

programme.title: Fukuoka, Japan Episode 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3 from Fukuoka, Japan.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles Sonny Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.desc: Chip es un nio de 9 aos que prefiere jugar con sus compaeros antes de las clases de fsica y qumica con su maestra Susan. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cmo regresar. Unos tomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrgeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarn para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podra ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensin, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el cientfico perdi durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No est construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa mquina que lo ayudar a esclavizar a todos los tomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus rdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente elctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. programme.title: 绝命法官Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 绝命法官Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia Season 1
programme.desc: This is the story of Julieta, a female golden dart frog, in search of her Romeo. Shes about to lay her eggs and must find a male to fertilize them. Romeos calls guide her through the forest, but crossing the dense rainforest is no easy feat.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals Season 1
programme.desc: Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World Season 1
programme.desc: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys Season 1
programme.desc: Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as The Child of Fire, this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern?

programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah mengenang saat dia kehilangan ibu dan bapanya, segala kenangan diimbas kembali dengan kesedihan yang tidak tertanggung. Kini, hidup Aisyah di penuhi dengan rasa sedih atas layanan dan sikap Mak Su Ainin dan dua orang sepupunya Fasha dan Farid. Aisyah melakukan semua pekerjaan di rumah selain mencari duit untuk diberikan kepada Mak Su Ainin sekeluarga. Sementara Fasha dan Farid hanya menanti Aisyah menandatangi surat penyerahan tanah kepada mereka yang dimiliki oleh arwah ibu dan bapa Aisyah. Semua ini atas arahan dan ajaran dari Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar lelaki yang hidup dengan kekayaan dan serba sempurna. Di kelilingi gadis-gadis cantik jelita persis model. Kehidupan dengan mengejar jawatan yang dijanjikan sebagai CEO di TG Holdings membuatkan Iskandar semakin hanyut melayari keseronokkan. Namun, cara hidup Iskandar tidak disenangi oleh Tengku Maria. Tengku Maria mula mencari jalan dengan menjodohkan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Hal itu membuatkan Iskandar memberontak dan meminta Haziq membawanya bercuti.

programme.desc: Keikhlasan mula membuka pintu kemaafan, namun luka lama masih meninggalkan parut.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Semasa sibuk menyiapkan dewan untuk program Jihad palestine, teman lelaki Qasih bernama Rudy datang dengan berseluar pendek, membawakan makanan untuk Qasih dan kehadirannya betul-betul memalukan Khatijah. Selepas Program berkenaan Khatijah memarahi Qasih sambil meluahkan rasa tidak senangnya dengan lelaki yang Qasih pilih. Alawiyah dan Khatijah meneruskan rancangannya untuk merapatkan Jazlan dan Qasih dengan menganjurkan Program Buka Kitab di rumah Alawiyah dengan Jazlan sebagai penceramahnya. Dan semasa ceramah berlangsung, Qasih telah mengajukan soalan kepada Ustaz Jazlan bagaiamanakah seorang ustaz itu boleh bercinta sekiranya ustaz berkenaan asyik tundukkan saje mukanya dan tidak berani memandang akan muka perempuan ?

Wajah Rasya juga ditutupi dengan topeng muka. Semua hadirin memakai topeng menutupi wajah. Rasya Aleeya terus berjalan. Seorang lelaki Syed Reeza memakai topeng muka mengajak Rasya menari. programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langityang mampu mengawal minda manusiaenam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP5
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah banglo lama yang dikatakan penuh mistri terletak di Branang, Selangor. En. Solo Ambush seorang penjejak paranormal menemami perantara. Banglo ini pernah didiami oleh sebuah keluarga Cina, disebabkan berlaku beberapa kejadian misteri dan menakutkan, mereka berpindah keluar. Pengantara bersama Solo Ambush, berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. Namun tiada lembaga yang muncul. Solo Ambush berkongsi pengalaman semasa menjalankan siasatan di situ

Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.
